alarms.title: AI missed a small repair area
alarms.operator_message: You marked 3 damaged areas. The AI found only 2. Check the third one.
alarms.technical_detail: Missing-volume finder returned 2 regions (confidence high). A third region marked by the operator (12 mm², 0.8 mm deep) is below the model's detection size of 20 mm², so it was dropped.

ground_truth.root_cause: Region smaller than the model's minimum detection size (AI miss).
ground_truth.consequence_if_ignored: One damaged area is left unrepaired.

hints: Your marks and the AI disagree. Your marks come from touching the real part.
Look at the third mark on the deviation map: is there a small dent?
Add the region with 'Add region from my marks', then confirm all three.

alarms.literature: Automatic detection of under-filled regions from point clouds: Pang et al. in Georgousis et al. 2026.
resolution_script: Your marks are right: the AI missed a small area.
Open the deviation map at your third mark.
Press 'AI was wrong' and choose 'missed area'.
Confirm all three regions, then press 'Problem solved'.

alarms.title: AI sees damage on a shiny, intact surface
alarms.operator_title: AI damage map: extra repair area
alarms.operator_message: The AI found a third damaged area where you marked nothing. It may be a scan error.
alarms.technical_detail: Region 3 lies on a polished surface where 41% of scan points are missing; the missing points look like lost volume to the model. Confidence medium.

ai_decision.what: 3 repair regions found (region 3 on the polished face)

ground_truth.root_cause: Reflective surface caused missing scan data (false region).
ground_truth.consequence_if_ignored: Material deposited on an intact surface.

expected_response.resolved_when: Only the two real regions are confirmed.

hints: Shiny metal confuses the scanner. Holes in the scan can look like damage.
Feel or look at the part where region 3 is. Is it really damaged?
If not, remove region 3, press 'AI was wrong', and confirm the other two.

alarms.literature: Scanning challenges on reflective surfaces: Li et al. 2026; region segmentation: Georgousis et al. 2026.
resolution_script: Region 3 is probably a scan error on the shiny surface.
Look at the part there. Is it really damaged?
If not, press 'Remove region' on region 3.
Press 'AI was wrong' and choose 'scan error'.
Confirm the two real regions, then press 'Problem solved'.

alarms.title: Build plan from AI is uncertain
alarms.operator_message: The AI proposes 7 layers. It is not sure: it saw only one similar repair.
alarms.technical_detail: Bead-geometry regressor proposes 7 layers at 2.0 mm with a wide 90% interval (5-9 layers); the thin-wall geometry is outside most of the training data (only 1 similar case). Models trained on single beads on flat plates transfer poorly to such geometry.

ai_decision.what: 7 layers, 2.0 mm layer height, 200 °C max interpass

ground_truth.root_cause: Too little training data for this geometry; the real need is 9 layers.
ground_truth.consequence_if_ignored: Repair ends too low; rework needed.

expected_response.resolved_when: Plan chosen with a qualified recipe or engineer approval, with layer checks on.

hints: A wide range means the AI is guessing.
Open 'Similar past repairs': only one example looks like this part.
Use the approved recipe for thin walls (or ask the engineer) and turn on the layer checks.

alarms.literature: Uncertainty rarely reported; offline models trained on single beads: Georgousis et al. 2026.
resolution_script: The AI is guessing: it saw only one repair like this.
Press 'Use approved recipe' and choose 'Thin wall'.
Press 'Problem solved' and write which recipe you chose.
